name: Signal Demodulation & Decoding
description: Ability to demodulate and decode captured RF signals to extract data content. Covers identification of modulation schemes (AM, FM, PSK, FSK, QAM, OFDM), construction of demodulation chains, symbol timing recovery, error correction handling, and extraction of protocol-layer data from baseband signals.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to signal demodulation techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands common modulation schemes and the concept of demodulation
evidence: Can identify AM, FM, and common digital modulation types from descriptions
Understands the relationship between modulation, bandwidth, and data rate

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Demodulates known signal types using existing tools and flowgraphs under supervision
evidence: Demodulated FM broadcast and narrowband FM signals using GNU Radio under guidance
Applied existing demodulation flowgraphs to decode standard protocols (e.g., ADS-B, POCSAG)
Identified modulation type from waterfall and constellation diagram inspection with assistance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently identifies modulation schemes and builds demodulation chains for standard signal types
evidence: Independently identified and demodulated 5+ different modulation schemes from captured signals
Built custom GNU Radio demodulation flowgraphs for non-trivial signal types
Correctly recovered symbol timing and applied appropriate error correction
Documented demodulation parameters and signal characteristics for lab records

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Demodulates complex and non-standard signals; develops reusable demodulation tools
evidence: Demodulated spread-spectrum, frequency-hopping, or multi-carrier signals
Developed reusable demodulation modules for recurring lab signal types
Recovered data from signals with poor SNR or interference
Mentors junior analysts on modulation identification and demodulation chain construction

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Demodulates novel or proprietary modulation schemes; advances lab demodulation capabilities
evidence: Reverse-engineered proprietary modulation schemes from unknown signal captures
Published research on novel demodulation techniques or signal analysis methods
Designed the lab's demodulation reference library and methodology
Trains teams on advanced demodulation and signal decoding

assessment_methods.description: Given blind signal captures with unknown modulation, identify the modulation scheme and extract the data payload
Review documented demodulation workflows and extracted data from recent engagements
